definition: Mosaic's unknown-dictionary fuzzy heavy hitters (B2.4): every point x of [0, 2^h1)^d with #{clients y : max_i |x_i - y_i| <= delta} >= T. All points of the domain are candidates (mosaic_others.rs:50,124-134); count and >= at mosaic_others.rs:77-84; L-infinity and its bound delta at util.rs:187-199,279-281; T absolute (cli_config.rs:28-29). The servers find it with the crawl of protocol.rs:559-760: a prefix box is kept if #{y : lo_i - delta <= y_i <= hi_i + delta for all i} >= T (the optimistic bound of util.rs:255-276; client intervals are clipped to the domain, share_phase.rs:58-64, so there is no wrap-around). H3: the crawl branches on i and j only (cli_config.rs:89-92); each full point gets its only possible k = i - j + 1024, is dropped if k is outside [0, 2^h1) (cli_config.rs:95-98), and gets a final check with all three coordinates (protocol.rs:768-840), so the answer is the set of H3 cells with >= T clients within delta hexagon steps.
